THE BUYING GUIDES

Start with your work.
Find a clearer next step.

Move from the question to the comparison, then use a practical scenario to decide what to test.

01
Should a small team use AI to produce ad creative or keep its existing design process?

Trial AI production when the brief is settled and making variants is the bottleneck.

More output will not prove that an offer works or that an ad will be profitable.

Understand the decision →
Compare the options →
Plan a practical pilot →
02
Should a small team pay to track its visibility in AI answers?

Track AI visibility once assistants influence how buyers describe you; start with your own prompts.

Better AI answers are not proven to lift revenue; the evidence on conversion impact is still open.

Understand the decision →
Compare the options →
Plan a practical pilot →
03
Does a growing marketplace brand need dedicated analytics software?

Buy the platform when competitor collection is a daily job, not a weekly favour.

Better dashboards do not prove better decisions; sales estimates stay estimates however they are styled.

HOW WE EVALUATE

Evidence you can follow.

Documentation research and hands-on testing answer different questions. We say which supports a conclusion.

Read the source

Important product statements link to named sources. Pricing needs a date, currency, billing term and a meaningful unit.

Match the context

A useful feature can still be a poor fit. We make the audience, operating constraints and reasons to choose another route visible.

Keep uncertainty visible

Missing cost, performance or usability evidence stays an open question. A pilot should resolve it before a larger commitment.
